[[Bloemfontein Celtic F.C.|Bloemfontein Celtic]] (Inland) | promoted = [[Bush Bucks F.C.|Bush Bucks]], [[Bloemfontein Celtic F.C.|Bloemfontein Celtic]] | relegated = | matches = | total goals = | prevseason = [[2002–03 National First Division|2002–03]] | nextseason = [[2004–05 National First Division|2004–05]] }} The '''2003–04 National First Division''' was the 8th season of the [[National First Division]], the second tier of South African [[Association football|soccer]]. It consisted of two streams, an Inland stream of 16 teams, and a Coastal stream of 14 teams. Fourteen teams were relegated as a result of the [[2004–05 National First Division]] combining the two streams into a single national league.{{Cite web |date=2004-08-26 |title=Clubs to strike gold |url=https://mg.co.za/article/2004-08-27-clubs-to-strike-gold/ |access-date=2023-08-10 |website=The Mail & Guardian |language=en-ZA}}{{Cite web |title=Premier Soccer League - www.psl.co.za - official website |url=https://www.psl.co.za/content/16306 |access-date=2023-08-10 |website=www.psl.co.za}} The Coastal stream was won by [[Bush Bucks F.C.|Bush Bucks]] and the Inland stream by [[Bloemfontein Celtic F.C.|Bloemfontein Celtic]], with both earning promotion to the [[2004–05 Premier Soccer League]].{{Cite web |date=25 May 2004 |title= Bucks and Celtic back in the big time|url=https://www.iol.co.za/capeargus/sport/bucks-and-celtic-back-in-the-big-time-535289 |access-date=2023-08-10 |website=Independent Online}} ==Coastal stream== ===League table=== {{#invoke:Sports table|main|style=WDL |res_col_header=PQR |update=complete |source={{Cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesz/zaf04.html|title=South Africa 2003/04}} |team1=LOU |name_LOU = [[Bush Bucks F.C.|Bush Bucks]] |team2=AVE |name_AVE = [[Avendale Athletico]] |team3=DUR |name_DUR = [[Durban Stars F.C.|Durban Stars]] |team4=FC |name_FC = [[FC Fortune]] |team5=VAS |name_VAS = [[Vasco da Gama (South Africa)|Vasco Da Gama]] |team6=MAR |name_MAR = [[Maritzburg United F.C.|Maritzburg United]] |team7=TIG |name_TIG = Basotho Tigers |team8=PJ |name_PJ = [[Uthukela]] |team9=BEN |name_BEN = [[Park United F.C.|Park United]] |team10=WIT |name_WIT = [[Rainbow Stars F.C.|Rainbow Stars]] |team11=ZUL |name_ZUL = [[Maritzburg City F.C.|Maritzburg City]] |team12=CIT |name_CIT = [[Premier United F.C.|Premier United]] |team13=WIN |name_WIN = [[African Wanderers F.C.|African Wanderers]] |team14=PRE |name_PRE = [[Blackburn Rovers F.C.
